theme_central: Allah's mercy (Ar-Rahman, sixteen occurrences) through the miraculous births of Yahya and Aissa — then, in a shift of tone, severity toward those who attribute a child to Him.
sources_note: 2-part structure with contrasting tones (1-58 tenderness, 59-98 severity) sourced (imamghazali.org). Sub-narratives (Zakariyya, Maryam, Ibrahim, gallery of prophets) well known and confirmed by the same source.

branches.title: Zakariyya and Yahya
branches.resume: Zakariyya's supplication for a son despite his old age, the announcement and birth of Yahya.

children.t: Zakariyya's secret supplication for a son despite his old age
Announcement and birth of Yahya, his righteousness from childhood

branches.title: Maryam and Aissa
branches.resume: Maryam's withdrawal, the angel's announcement, the miraculous birth of Aissa, refutation of the divinity attributed to him.

children.t: Maryam's withdrawal, the angel's announcement, the pains of childbirth
Aissa speaks from the cradle to defend his mother
Refutation: Allah has no son, Aissa is a word from Allah

branches.title: Ibrahim and the gallery of prophets
branches.resume: Ibrahim's call to his father, the break, then the mention of Musa, Isma'il and Idris.

children.t: Ibrahim's call to his father against idolatry, the break, the gift of Ishaq and Ya'qub
Musa, a pure messenger, Isma'il, truthful to his promises, Idris, raised in rank
Conclusion: those whom Allah favoured among the prophets

branches.title: Lost generations, resurrection
branches.resume: Those who abandoned prayer and followed their desires; all will cross over Hell before the pious are saved.

children.t: Generations who abandoned prayer, description of the promised Paradise
Doubt about the resurrection refuted; all will cross over, the pious saved

branches.title: Wealth and poverty, intercession
branches.resume: Contrast between the arrogance of the wealthy disbelievers and the poverty of the believers; no intercession without a covenant with Allah.

children.t: Arrogance of the wealthy disbelievers toward the modest believers
No intercession possible without a covenant granted by Allah

branches.title: Refutation, closing
branches.resume: Vehement refutation of attributing a son to Allah; the Qur'an made easy in the Arabic tongue.

children.t: The heavens almost collapsed at the attribution of a son to Allah
Allah will grant love to the pious; the Qur'an made easy in the Arabic tongue
